description: Implementation of VibrationElement and VibrationSequence classes for handling vibration patterns in Android input services.

classes.name: VibrationElement
classes.description: Represents a vibration event with duration and multiple channels.

classes.name: VibrationSequence
classes.description: Represents a sequence of VibrationElements forming a vibration pattern.

methods.name: VibrationElement::VibrationElement
methods.description: Constructor initializing channels with reserved size.

methods.name: VibrationElement::VibrationElement
methods.description: Copy constructor copying duration and channels.

methods.name: VibrationElement::toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the vibration element.

methods.name: VibrationElement::getMagnitude
methods.description: Returns the magnitude for a given vibrator ID, scaled to 16-bit range.

methods.name: VibrationElement::isOn
methods.description: Checks if any channel is active (non-zero amplitude).

methods.name: VibrationElement::addChannel
methods.description: Adds a channel with vibrator ID and amplitude.

methods.name: VibrationSequence::VibrationSequence
methods.description: Constructor reserving space for pattern elements.

methods.name: VibrationSequence::operator==
methods.description: Checks if two sequences are equal.

methods.name: VibrationSequence::addElement
methods.description: Adds a VibrationElement to the sequence.

methods.name: VibrationSequence::toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the vibration pattern sequence.
